description: Header file defining the SpdyFrameBuilder class, which provides facilities for constructing SPDY protocol frames, including methods for writing primitive data types and managing frame buffers.

classes.name: SpdyFrameBuilder
classes.description: A class for building SPDY protocol frames by appending primitive values and managing internal buffers.

methods.name: SpdyFrameBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the frame builder with a specified buffer size, optionally with an output buffer.

methods.name: length
methods.description: Returns the total size of the data in the frame builder.

methods.name: Seek
methods.description: Advances the write position by a specified number of bytes.

methods.name: BeginNewFrame
methods.description: Starts a new SPDY frame with specified type, flags, and stream ID.

methods.name: BeginNewFrame
methods.description: Starts a new SPDY frame with specified type, flags, stream ID, and length.

methods.name: BeginNewUncheckedFrame
methods.description: Starts a new frame with a raw frame type, flags, stream ID, and length, without validation.

methods.name: take
methods.description: Finalizes and retrieves the constructed frame buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt8
methods.description: Writes an 8-bit unsigned integer to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt16
methods.description: Writes a 16-bit unsigned integer in network byte order.

methods.name: WriteUInt24
methods.description: Writes a 24-bit unsigned integer in network byte order.

methods.name: WriteUInt32
methods.description: Writes a 32-bit unsigned integer in network byte order.

methods.name: WriteUInt64
methods.description: Writes a 64-bit unsigned integer in network byte order.

methods.name: WriteStringPiece32
methods.description: Writes a string as a 32-bit length-prefixed piece.

methods.name: WriteBytes
methods.description: Writes raw bytes to the buffer.
